headline: Gate D first half (growth & division, Option B MEASURED critical-geometry — NOT CG membrane mechanics): verdict=qualified. On study-32's self-maintaining protocell, membrane area grows from the real metabolic amphiphile flux and the compartment divides at a measured area-doubling budding geometry (no imposed event). Division RATE scales with metabolic flux in the coupled arm (rate 0.0125 -> 0.0500 as flux 3.36e-04 -> 1.16e-03; slope 4.57e+01 > 0) while the growth-decoupled null is flux-INDEPENDENT (slope -2.79e-31 ~ 0), and the imposed-division null divides on a timer (rate 0.0437) regardless of geometry. Daughters are viable (resume the study-32 self-maintenance criterion) across the sweep. So growth and division FOLLOW from metabolism + measured geometry and beat both matched nulls at equal feeds; qualified because this is the measured-geometry first cut (CG membrane mechanics = Option A / og-33a, budgeted follow-on). Metabolism = sustained A1 network, NOT autocatalytic (A2 refuted).
